title: Dove moisturising claims supported by US advertising watchdog after P&G challenge
summary: The National Advertising Division supported claims related to Unilever-owned Dove’s Deep Moisture Body Wash, which were challenged by Procter and Gamble, including that the product offers 24-hours of moisturisation and nourishes dry skin

extraction.key_fact: 미국 광고 자율심의기구가 P&G가 문제 삼은 도브 바디워시의 보습 광고 표현을 인정했다.
